title: Open Source Language Models Can Provide Feedback: Evaluating LLMs’ Ability to Help Students Using GPT-4-As-A-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing GPT-4's automated quality ratings (completeness, perceptivity, selectivity) of LLM-generated programming feedback against expert human ground truth annotations to measure the model's tendency to systematically over-rate or grade more positively than human experts.

Evaluating GPT-4's potential favoritism toward models of its own family by analyzing its high rating of GPT-3.5 generated feedback compared to human evaluations and discussing the algorithmic bias of LLM-as-a-judge models favoring their own outputs.
